decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard to power out powerful creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, while also generating advantage through cards like Cabal Therapy and Faithless Looting. By filling the graveyard with cards using cards like Breakthrough and Golgari Thug, the deck aims to bring back powerful creatures like Thassa's Oracle with Dread Return to win the game quickly and efficiently. The deck also has ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Poxwalkers and Otherworldly Gaze.

This deck utilizes lands to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy involves using cards like Exploration and Crop Rotation to quickly develop a strong mana base, while also utilizing cards like Maze of Ith and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's creatures and lands. The deck also aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo to create a powerful 20/20 indestructible Marit Lage token. Additionally, cards like Sylvan Library and Urza's Saga provide card advantage and additional utility.

The primary strategy of this deck is to utilize Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to quickly put powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play without paying their high mana costs. The deck also includes cards like Stock Up and Omniscience to help manipulate the game in your favor. With a strong suite of card draw and counterspells such as Brainstorm, Ponder, and Force of Will, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats early in the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bring them back into play using cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. Utilizing cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to find the right creatures and mana acceleration, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents with high-impact plays. Additionally, control elements like Force of Will and Wasteland help protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's strategies. The goal is to efficiently combo off and win before the opponent can establish a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively ramp up mana production using cards like Eldrazi Temple, Grim Monolith, Lotus Petal, and Ancient Tomb to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher. Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls help protect your creatures from opposing spells, while Glaring Fleshraker and Wastescape Battlemage provide additional threats and disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast mana acceleration and efficient Eldrazi threats to close out games quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck focuses on sacrificing cards like Cabal Therapy and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently reanimating threats to overwhelm them. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual allows for explosive plays and the ability to cheat out expensive creatures early in the game. The deck aims to combo off and win the game before the opponent can establish their own board presence.

The deck relies on quickly filling the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then using Reanimate to bring back powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps with card draw and manipulation, while Wasteland and Brazen Borrower provide additional disruption. Overall, the deck aims to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. Thoughtseize and Force of Will provide disruption against opposing strategies, while cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help with card selection and drawing into combo pieces. Additionally, Daze and Wasteland provide additional disruption and tempo advantage, making it difficult for opponents to recover once the combo is initiated.

The deck revolves around the strategy of cheating out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using the card Show and Tell. By using cards like Sneak Attack and Omniscience, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and high-impact plays. The deck includes counterspells like Spell Pierce and Flusterstorm to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base consists of lands like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors to support the deck's fast mana requirements.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly applying pressure with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and Brazen Borrower for tempo plays. Mishra's Bauble helps to fuel delve for threats like Murktide Regent. Wasteland is used to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help to smooth out draws and find the necessary pieces for victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's strategies and gaining card advantage. It utilizes cards like Force of Will, Counterbalance, and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect its own threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Jace, the Mind Sculptor. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with any threats the opponent may play. By managing the game state and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to establish a strong presence on the battlefield and dictate the pace of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back onto the battlefield for a low cost. By combining powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate, you can overwhelm your opponent with threats early in the game. This deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect your combo pieces and control the game. Overall, the goal is to outpace and outvalue your opponent with efficient reanimation strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble an infinite mana combo using cards like Urza's Tower, Grim Monolith, and Basalt Monolith, and then use Mystic Forge to cast artifacts from the top of the library, eventually finding and playing The One Ring to win the game. The deck also includes cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Karn, the Great Creator for control and disruption, as well as ramp and card draw options to help set up the combo. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful finish.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands to cast powerful threats like Emrakul, Ulamog, and Karn. It also uses cards like Crop Rotation to tutor for key lands, Bojuka Bog to disrupt graveyard strategies, and Karn's Sylex to disrupt opponents' artifacts. The control aspect comes from using cards like Kozilek's Command and Ugin to remove threats, while also having access to powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Planar Nexus for additional control and board presence. The deck's goal is to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and control elements.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive permanents like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually building up its own resources to eventually dominate the game and win through incremental advantage.

The main focus of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt your opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void while applying pressure with powerful creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to control the board with efficient removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption, while also utilizing ramp and acceleration with cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to lock down your opponent's resources while overwhelming them with fast and aggressive threats.
